title: Kadhalil Vizhunthen
desc: Sabhapathy, a footballer, finds his lover dead after returning from his match. Unable to bear the grief, he slips into depression and yearns to become one with her.

title: Ponniyin Selvan: Part Two
desc: Prince Aditha Karikalan attempts to tackle the attacks of Pandyas, Rashtrakutas and other enemies on the Chola dynasty in the wake of the presumed death of his brother Ponniyin Selvan.

title: Alex Pandian
desc: Alex, a small-time thief, gets a contract to kidnap the chief minister's daughter, Divya, for three days. But when Divya reveals to him the real reason for her kidnap, he decides to help her.

title: Naane Varuven
desc: When Prabhu's daughter gets possessed by a young boy, the distraught father's desperation to save his child leads him to his estranged twin, who has serial killing tendencies.

title: Naan Mirugamaai Maara
desc: Bhoominathan seeks revenge after his brother gets murdered. So, he hires some contract killers but soon realises that his family's safety is on the line.
